heading: INT. CORPORATE OFFICE - SEVENTH-FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. CORPORATE OFFICE - SEVENTH-FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
A glass box overlooking a parking structure.
A whiteboard reads SYNERGY SPRINT in three colors of marker.
A bowl of untouched fruit.
DEBORAH QUILL (40s, VP of Culture, lanyard, smile fixed) stands at the head of the table.
RAJ PATWARDHAN (30s, analyst, laptop open, tie loosened) sits halfway down.
CHLOE BEAUMONT (20s, intern, notebook on her knee) sits at the far end, as if hoping to be forgotten.
So. We're all aligned that the new initiative is a game-changer.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: Which initiative?
units.name: RAJ

units.text: The one in the email.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: There were four emails.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: The one with the rocket emoji.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: That was a typo. It was supposed to be a calendar.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: The rocket stays. The rocket is the brand.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: Deborah, with respect, the rocket is a tool that reassigns three departments to a platform we have not purchased.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Which is why we're being proactive.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: We are being fictional.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: We are being agile.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: We are being laid off. In five weeks. By the rocket.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Raj, I'd love for you to hear yourself.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: I hear myself. I've heard myself since Q2. Nobody else seems to.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Chloe, what do you think?
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: Is the bowl of fruit for us?
units.name: CHLOE

units.text: It's for morale.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: It has been there since Monday.
units.name: CHLOE

units.text: Fruit takes time to work.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: Deborah.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Yes, Raj.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: I'm resigning.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: You can't, we have a retrospective.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: That's the best argument for it.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Then let's do the retrospective first, and you can resign after as a, quote, learning.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: I'll take the fruit.
units.name: RAJ

units.text: Take two.
units.name: DEBORAH

units.text: Raj picks up the bowl and walks out.
Deborah stares at the door.
Chloe slowly raises her hand.
Can I go with him?
units.name: CHLOE

units.text: Please. Take notes.
units.name: DEBORAH
